cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You spilled one cup. From now on, drinks need pouring permits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'll appoint a pouring supervisor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if the supervisor spills one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll add an appeals procedure before we serve anything.

mechanism: Copy tapping a teapot without its purpose, then turn both the spill and the cleanup problem into new handling rules.
confusable: Not ordinary caution after a spill: B2 must identify the misunderstood copied tapping and A3 refuse to admit it.
comparison: A shared table spill differs from controlling a family photograph.
seedUse: Uses spill-to-rules from canonical Drive; replaces permits/appeals with lid markings and paper placement.
